It is located in {{ill|Izu Province|ar|مقاطعة إزو|be|Ідзу (правінцыя)|ckb|پارێزگای ئیزو|cs|Provincie Izu|cv|Идзу|de|Provinz Izu|es|Provincia de Izu|fa|ولایت ایزو|fr|Province d'Izu|gl|Provincia de Izu|hak|Yî-theu-koet|id|Provinsi Izu|it|Izu (provincia)|ja|伊豆国|ko|이즈국|lt|Idzu žemė|nl|Izu (provincie)|pl|Prowincja Izu|pt|Província de Izu|ru|Идзу (провинция)|simple|Izu Province|sk|Izu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Изу|th|แคว้นอิซุ|tr|Izu (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ідзу|zh|伊豆國|zh_min_nan|Izu-kok|zh_yue|伊豆國|qid=Q860928|lt=Izu Province}}.

The shrine is situated near the summit of Takenohira (also read Takinohira) Mountain, in the mountains of the Izu district in the northwestern part of Miyakejima, east of {{ill|Gosai-jinjna|ja|御祭神社|qid=Q131925937}}.

It is identified as '''Yasunomikoto Shrine''' (yasunomikoto-jinja), a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} dedicated to Yasu no Mikoto, the third child among the eight princes born to {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945|lt=Kotoshironushi}} (Mishima Daimyōjin) and his consort Sakitamahime no Mikoto (the enshrined deity of {{ill|Oshaku Shrine|ja|御笏神社|qid=Q110915859}}), who is known as "Yasu." However, another Ronsha candidate is the Ontake Shrine, which was merged into {{ill|Ninomiya Shrine (Q134930277)|ja|二宮神社 (三宅村)|qid=Q134930277|lt=Ninomiya Shrine}} in the Tsubota district<ref name="engi-chosa"/><ref name="miyake">[https://www.soumu.metro.tokyo.lg.jp/14miyake/miyakehp/kankousasshi_0503.pdf 三宅島 p.84] - 東京都/三宅島観光協会</ref><ref name="jyr">[https://jun-yu-roku.com/shrine/engishiki/izu/ 伊豆國 九十二座] - 神社巡遊録</ref><ref>''{{ill|Miyakeki|ja|三宅記|qid=Q17215100}}''</ref>.
